name: wf-step-retrieve-keywords
description: Keyword-fan-out retrieval: a list of terms in, ranked passages out. Probes kb.chunks.fts once for the whole list to decide which terms the library actually covers, searches the covered ones as one blended query through wf-step-retrieve, and sends each uncovered term to the web arm on its own. Returns the same two shapes as wf-step-retrieve -- `text` gives a single [S1]..[Sn]/[W1]..[Wn] block, `rows` gives structured rows with chunk_id.

parameters.query:
-- Coverage probe for the whole keyword list in one call. nlq.corpus_coverage is
-- SECURITY DEFINER because agent_ro holds NO privilege on kb -- measured
-- 2026-09-17, has_schema_privilege('n8n_agent','kb','USAGE') = false -- and
-- reaches the corpus only through vetted nlq functions. Reading kb.chunks
-- directly from this node fails with "permission denied for schema kb".
--
-- ⛔ Deliberately NOT nlq.corpus_vocabulary_gap. That function needs two known
-- lexemes before it reports anything, which a bare keyword rarely has. measured
-- 2026-09-17: 'poppy seeds' is absent from the corpus and still returns
-- gap_terms = {}, while 'crushed poppy seeds' -- the same ingredient -- returns
-- {poppi}. Per keyword its routing is decided by phrase length, not by coverage.
SELECT term, fts_hits
FROM nlq.corpus_coverage(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)));
